office_does: A Grant County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases and traffic infractions, sets bail and holds preliminary hearings; all three judges are elected countywide to four-year terms.
race_blurb: Uncontested open seat: Superior Court Commissioner Tom Middleton is the only candidate to succeed retiring Judge Brian Barlow.

candidates.summary: Grant County Superior Court commissioner since 2017, a former Ephrata lawyer, city council member and business owner; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Grant County Superior Court commissioner since 2017 [S1]
Associate and partner at Hansen and Middleton Law Firm, 1996-2004 [S1]
Ephrata City Council 2004-2008; ran the family pool and spa business 2004-2016 [S1]
